summary: Verified the 4 bug-fixes on the BRK painel (admin login, client-side admin routes, refresh session+page persistence, real-time access activity, overdue invoice color, tab title). Backend: 8/8 pytest passed. Frontend: found and FIXED a critical regression in admin nav routing (relative NavLink/Navigate inside splat route caused runaway URLs + infinite render loop). After fix, all nav tabs route correctly with 0 loop errors. All other features pass.

ui_bugs.issue: FIXED by testing agent. Clicking nav tabs produced runaway URLs like /donaspainel/dashboard/faturas/dashboard/dashboard/... and an infinite 'Maximum update depth exceeded' render loop. Root cause: react-router v7 relative NavLink to="faturas" + inner <Navigate to="dashboard"> resolving against the full splat path of the /donaspainel/* route. Fixed by making NavLink targets and inner index/catch-all Navigate absolute (/donaspainel/<tab>).

action_items: Review/keep the PanelLayout.jsx fix applied by the testing agent (relative -> absolute routes). This was the ADMIN ROUTES bug; it was broken before the fix.
critical_code_review_comments: PanelLayout.jsx used relative NavLink/Navigate targets inside a splat route (/donaspainel/*) which under react-router-dom 7.18.4 appended to the full current path, producing an infinite redirect loop. Always use absolute paths for links/redirects when the layout is mounted on a splat route, or restructure as a proper layout route with nested child routes + <Outlet/>.

minhabrk.html uses relative var API='/api' which works only because the iframe is served from the frontend origin and ingress proxies /api to backend; acceptable here but brittle if the page is ever hosted elsewhere.
AuthContext revalidation correctly hydrates from localStorage and only logs out on 401/403 - refresh persistence verified working.

rca of the issue: ADMIN ROUTES bug RCA: In PanelLayout.jsx, TABS used relative NavLink to="dashboard|faturas|..." and the inner <Routes> used <Navigate to="dashboard"> (relative). PanelLayout is mounted as the element of the splat route path='/donaspainel/*' in App.js. Under react-router-dom 7.18.4, relative links/redirects within a splat route resolve against the FULL current pathname (including the splat segment), so clicking 'faturas' from /donaspainel/dashboard produced /donaspainel/dashboard/faturas; that path matched the inner catch-all which redirected (relative) to 'dashboard', appending again -> /donaspainel/dashboard/faturas/dashboard -> infinite loop ('Maximum update depth exceeded'). Reproduction: login, click any nav tab. Mitigation (applied): changed NavLink targets and inner index/catch-all Navigate to absolute paths (/donaspainel/<tab>). Retested: all tabs route to the correct clean URL, 0 infinite-loop errors.
